records.title: Verifiable by Design: Aligning Language Models to Quote from Pre-Training Data
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.03862. Primary abstract proposes quote-tuning for verifiability/truthfulness; it reports quality gains and does not address inference efficiency.

records.title: Are Large Kernels Better Teachers than Transformers for ConvNets?
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.19412. Primary abstract studies ConvNet knowledge distillation for image classification, a training task outside language-model inference.

records.title: A Frustratingly Easy Post-Training Quantization Scheme for LLMs
records.reason: It is an LLM post-training quantization method, but the reviewed evidence is quality/perplexity rather than measured serving-efficiency; practical speed gains are not established in this paper.

records.title: Fixing MoE Over-Fitting on Low-Resource Languages in Multilingual Machine Translation
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.07571. Primary abstract studies regularization for multilingual MoE translation quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Looped Reasoning Language Models
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11791. Primary abstract is a mechanistic analysis of looped reasoning models, without an inference-efficiency method or measurement.
